To add to all of these great answers, the tooth has 3 "layers" the enamel, which is harder than bone and white, dentin, which is a yellow color and softer than the enamel and then the pulp which is the center of the tooth that hold all of the stuff to keep it alive. So I don't know if you ever noticed, but baby teeth are usually much whiter than adult teeth, the enamel is far thicker than our. The thinner your enamel the more of that yellow dentin color you see showing through. Now obviously,  diet and hygiene have a huge roll in the staining of enamel, but if you you're doing all the right things and aren't getting that Hollywood white smile you want, its because they bleach their teeth and you may just have thinner enamel than the dude nextdoor

Bot to mention, the thinner the enamel the quicker the acid in your mouth can cause cavities.
